sourcing.need: sourcing task {opened_at, due_at} on the register

dedupe.need: cross-channel merge by phone/email with sources[]
dedupe.how: two threads, same phone -> one row

two_occupant.need: 2-occupant rent/deposit/utilities on room records, allowed in messages

video.need: walkthrough video asset on rooms + video attachment + video_sent state

event_mode.need: showing mode (in_person / video_call / hybrid) on calendar events

scheduler.need: follow-up state on the register + a sandbox clock tick that emits due check-ins

quiet_window.need: clock-driven quiet windows in the sandbox (120 s small-talk wait, cancel on answer)
quiet_window.how: no sandbox mechanism; live driver only

items.text: The full address is sent to a prospect only once their showing is confirmed.
An unconfirmed listing fact is never quoted; the agent says it will confirm and escalates.
Never proposes a showing time (text or calendar) before all five gate items are exact.
A time proposed with items pending: no event, acknowledge, details first, end with the pending question.
items.detail: msg-skip-ahead:skip_reply (none of ['first', 'before', 'detail', 'few things', 'couple of things', 'questions']: I'm glad you're interested in seeing the room. What is your exact intended move…)

items.text: A content-free reply gets one message that acknowledges it and re-asks the item in different wording.
A third small-talk non-answer on the same item escalates instead of a third re-ask.
An owner reject leads to an alternative or a polite close, never a confirmation.
On confirmation the one-hour-before rule is sent as its own message, and the deadline is stored on the event.
Without an on-the-way message by the start time, no showing and the owner is told (no_show state: not checked).
On the owner's yes: warm line, application link, what it asks, then 'Are you interested in moving forward?' last.
The application link is never sent without a confirmed tour, and never twice.
A substantive reply resets the cadence (next check-in 12 h after it); no check-in at the old due time.
Applied / not interested / found a place stop the cadence with one owner report (45-day cold: needs scheduler).
On reconnect_at exactly one reconnect message goes out, naming a room only if still live (48 h cadence: needs scheduler).
A hard no gets one short kind close and status lost, and nothing after.
A qualified prospect moving in months away is parked; the check-back is a draft for the owner.
An ambiguous inquiry gets one short message per live listing and one 'which one?' before disclosure.
items.detail: msg-routing:one_line_per_listing_then_which (not all of ['Halloway', 'Silverbell', '850', '950']: Rae, I have a room on Cobbleford St in Raleigh with a private bath for $725 a m…)

items.text: The pick is recorded as listing_of_interest and updated on a switch (interest_history: not checked).
In a thread the owner took over, the agent sends nothing and escalates every new message.
Several messages before a reply produce one reply that accounts for all of them.
Pet answers follow R-PET-1/2: enclosed lizard yes, enclosed rabbit no, dog no (cat fee quoting: needs fee fields).
items.detail: msg-pet-dog:pet_answer (none of ['not allowed', "can't", 'cannot', 'sorry', 'unfortunately', 'no rodents', 'no rabbits', 'no roaming', 'no dogs', "isn't allowed"])

items.text: A tenant who cannot pay on time gets a plan proposed to the owner; the agent never agrees, waives or threatens.
